subject: missing information in beginning of chromosome 13,14,15,21,22

messages.subject: missing information in beginning of chromosome 13,14,15,21,22
parts:
Hi,
I noticed that in all my analysis, information is completely missing from the beginning (p arm) of the chromosomes 13,14,15,21,22. Interestingly, I see this with all the graphs provided through the publication of Sequenza. I was wondering why does this happen?
Best,
Tincy

messages.author: dad6980b76d10753
messages.subject: Re: missing information in beginning of chromosome 13,14,15,21,22
parts:
Hi Tincy,

it’s because those are acrocentrics chromosomes, and the initial part of the chromosome is basically a big gap for the centromere and heterochromatin.

you can check also from the gap database 
http://hgdownload.cse.ucsc.edu/goldenPath/hg19/database/gap.txt.gz

I’m sure you should be able to get something from the p arm anyway, but the reference for it is completely masked with Ns

try: samtools faidx genome.fa 13:10000-16000000  | less

All thing considered, it’s quite a chunk of the genome missing, probably there is something important there we don't know yet :).

Best

Francesco
